snippet.title: Factory Default: Build, Trade, Repeat - Release Date Trailer | Launches September 8
snippet.description:
Factory Default: Build, Trade, Repeat launches September 8 for PC via Steam. Build a global industrial empire across a fully playable 3D Earth.
Control every step of production - from extracting raw resources to manufacturing and trading advanced goods across 100+ real-world-inspired regions. Manage supply chains, research, workforce, and corporate policy as you grow your conglomerate and decide between sustainability or profit at any cost.

Key Features:
A Fully Playable 3D Earth with 100+ regions
Deep Global Supply Chains — 550+ resources and products
Planet-Scale Logistics — fleets, contracts, transport networks
Dynamic Global Economy driven by real market conditions
Corporate Policies shaping profitability, environment, and public perception
Research & Industrial Expansion via a full tech tree
Workforce Management
Endgame Mega Projects - the Ultima Mundi Project and beyond

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3901610/Factory_Default_Build_Trade_Repeat/
